source_row.rationale: Comprehensive heart failure readmission prevention programs are intended to reduce preventable readmissions by addressing common contributing factors, such as medication non-adherence, dietary indiscretion, and delayed symptom recognition, through structured discharge education and early follow-up.
source_row.source_name: CMS / AHA — Heart Failure Readmission Reduction Strategies
